propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries (claude-haiku, claude-sonnet, claude-opus) are hardcoded model names that infer to Anthropic provider regardless of configured provider, causing split-brain routing when runs are configured for another provider like Bedrock
models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic model names for escalation even when called with a Bedrock-qualified id, causing escalation to silently switch providers
MODEL_LADDER serves dual roles (escalation order and context-window sizing) but the ladder expansion at cfg.model and three other sites copies model_ladder[0] directly without resolution

Expressing the ladder as reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) and resolving them through class config at runtime makes the ladder provider-portable and fixes escalation routing without breaking context-window substring matching
